İstanbul İlçelere ve Müşteri Tipine Göre Doğalgaz Verisi

description: İstanbul İstatistik Ofisi: energy datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by İstanbul İstatistik Ofisi. Coverage: Istanbul. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about energy; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: İstanbul Çöp Gazından Üretilen Enerji Miktarları; Aylık Perakende Gaz Satış Fiyatlandırılması; İstanbul İlçelere ve Müşteri Tipine Göre Doğalgaz Verisi. Formats seen: XLSX, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
